chunks: 2191 - Umm Salamah, may Allah be pleased with her, came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and said: “O Messenger of Allah, al-Aḍḥā is approaching, and I do not have the price of the uḍḥiyah. Should I borrow and offer a sacrifice?”
So he said: “Borrow and offer the sacrifice, for it is a debt that will be repaid.”

key_terms.الْأُضْحِيَّةِ: the sacrificial animal offered on Eid al-Aḍḥā
key_terms.ثَمَنُ: the price or cost of something

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to borrow money in order to offer the Eid al-Aḍḥā sacrifice?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that Umm Salamah asked the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم whether she should borrow money to perform the uḍḥiyah when she lacked its cost. He instructed her to borrow and perform it, indicating permissibility in this context and describing the loan as a debt that will be repaid.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2191 - Umm Salamah, may Allah (swt) be pleased with her, came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, and said:
"O Messenger of Allah (swt), the Day of Sacrifice is approaching, and I do not have the means to afford a sacrifice. Should I borrow and offer a sacrifice?"
He (sw) replied: "Borrow and offer a sacrifice, for it is a debt that will be repaid."
